test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 23 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts and decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements.

**Statements :**

Some files are photos.

All photos are pictures.

**Conclusions :**

(I) No pictures are files.

(II) Some pictures are files.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20194398b190e0574ada7d7cd1cfb781b7b6624ee9afcad89d938b6cece96708.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) No pictures are files → Does not Follow (As some files are photos and all photos are pictures. As no direct relation is given between files and pictures, therefore it is false.)

(II) Some pictures are files → Follow (As some files are photos and all photos are pictures. As some part of files is common with photos which comes in pictures, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (II) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"
